summary: Project the Three-Layer Vault onto a virtual disk mount using OpenViking's viking:// URI protocol, implement L0/L1/L2 tiered loading hierarchy, and add automated nightly context compaction.
resolution: Implemented Viking VFS server tiering (L0/L1/L2), context compaction (scripts/viking-compact-vault.mjs), and merged hybrid RRF & Viking VFS benchmark suite in PR #83.
